name: Borges's Hoard
purpose: The user's personal library: folders of their own documents, and their own Faustus conversations and the links they saved in Links Hoard, indexed locally so the assistant can answer 'where did I read/write/decide X' with exact page, section and chat-turn citations.
notes: Keep the app running (python -m borges) while the assistant uses it: the MCP bridge proxies every call to the local server and never opens the database. The first start downloads a ~240 MB multilingual embedding model into data/models; until it is ready, search is keyword-only.
